mapper.insert: insert into aira_user_card (qq_number, card_id, card_number, create_time, update_time) values ( #{qqNumber}, #{cardId}, 1, #{createTime}, #{createTime} ) ON CONFLICT (qq_number, card_id) DO UPDATE SET card_number = CASE WHEN aira_user_card.card_number = 5 THEN 5 ELSE aira_user_card.card_number + 1 END, update_time = now()
